title: Feedback During Massage
summary: Comfort is best checked with brief questions and observation throughout the session.
goal: Make feedback a continuous part of safe practice.
startingPosition: Agree beforehand that pain, numbness, dizziness, or discomfort should be reported.
instructions: Ask about pressure after the first passes.
Reduce intensity if the person tenses.
Stop with pain, numbness, or dizziness.
Do not encourage someone to tolerate pain.
direction: This rule applies throughout the session.
tips: Uncertainty is enough reason to reduce intensity or postpone massage.
Safety takes priority over completing a plan.
mistakes: Trying to continue at any cost.
Making overly confident conclusions without professional assessment.
warning: This guide is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis or individualized professional advice.
